source_title: Tottenham transfer rumours: Nicolo Tresoldi, Pedro Porro - BBC
source_excerpt:
Tottenham, Arsenal , Manchester United and Chelsea are keeping a close eye on Nicolo Tresoldi, but Club Brugge have no intention of selling the 22-year-old German striker in January. (Football Insider) , external
Meanwhile, Barcelona president Joan Laporta is keen on bringing Spurs full-back Pedro Porro to the club. (3Cat, in Catalan) , external
Finally, Tottenham will not receive additional funds from Bayern Munich as Harry Kane's transfer to the Bundesliga giants in 2023 did not include a Ballon d'Or clause. (Goal) , external
